prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, healthy natural skin with real texture, not airbrushed, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: Lauren, a fictional 50-year-old, Natalie's controlling stepmother, George's wife and Cassie's mother, who holds the family purse; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: A well-kept, ordinary-looking Caucasian woman of 50, about 166 cm. Curvy figure, full hips, defined waist, hourglass shape. She has an oval face with sharp, arched brows, thin lips in a mauve lipstick, cool grey eyes and fine lines at the eyes and mouth. Shoulder-length honey-blonde hair is set in a smooth, polished blow-out. She wears pearl stud earrings, a large diamond solitaire ring and a slim gold wristwatch.. Wearing one outfit only: A plum-purple silk long-sleeved blouse with a soft bow at the neck, tucked into high-waisted black tailored trousers, with black pointed-toe heels, pearl studs and a slim gold wristwatch.. Signature colour: purple. In the close-up a calm, attractive expression with bright, intelligent eyes and only a hint of: Cold, possessive and contemptuous. She reminds George that everything he has is hers, dotes on Cassie, and enjoys trading Natalie away for Cassie's benefit.; no tears. The full-body views keep the body's build and proportions as the appearance gives them, head-to-body ratio included, never slimmer. Cast as a commercial live-action short drama: a lead (the heroine, the hero) or a young adult woman in a prominent role is a strikingly beautiful or handsome, camera-ready actor, with the figure, make-up and hair the appearance gives; any other supporting role is an ordinary-looking person of that age.
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 50, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
